You are running one arm of a job sweep. Use ONLY WebSearch and WebFetch. Never use curl, wget, python requests, or bash to fetch web pages — prohibited here.

CANDIDATE: Prabhavit Gupta, Venice, Italy. Italian EU long-term residence permit, needs NO sponsorship anywhere in the EU. ~3 years professional, all European startups, most recently Lead Developer at FlowSpace, Mar 2024 to Jul 2026, available now. No CS degree. English professional, Hindi native, Italian beginner — any role needing professional Italian/German/French/Dutch/Spanish is OUT.
Targets, in priority order: (A) AI/automation engineering, (B) forward-deployed / solutions / implementation engineering, (C) full-stack product engineering (TypeScript, Next.js, Laravel, Supabase), (D) technical product management.
Evidence: shipped production AI agents; grew FlowSpace 2,000 to 4,500+ users; led live migration Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel; API integrations (Office RnD, Nexudus, Sendgrid, Google APIs, OpenAI/Anthropic, Eden AI); GTM/lead-enrichment automation.

YOUR ARM: JOB BOARDS, fetched directly for breadth and freshness. Prefer roles posted in the last 30 days, ideally the last 7.

FETCH these (WebFetch). Ask each a targeted question, e.g. "list the AI, automation, solutions engineering, full-stack and technical product roles on this page with their company, title, URL, location wording and how long ago they were posted":
- https://euremotejobs.com/job-region/remote-jobs-europe/
- https://euremotejobs.com/job-region/remote-jobs-emea/
- https://euremotejobs.com/jobs/remote-software-engineering-jobs/
- https://euremotejobs.com/job-region/italy/
- https://arbeitnow.com/api/job-board-api   (clean JSON: title, company, remote, location, tags, created_at epoch. DACH-heavy and mixed non-tech, filter hard)
- https://remoteok.com/api                  (JSON only. IGNORE its salary_min/salary_max, they are always 0)
- https://aijobs.net/                        (best salary transparency of any board, EUR bands on most rows)
Then SERIALIZE these (himalayas 429s under concurrency, and its paths do not compose):
- https://himalayas.app/jobs/countries/italy
- https://himalayas.app/jobs/engineering
Himalayas uniquely states the region restriction per job ("Netherlands only", "Global", "United Kingdom only") — that kills the secretly-US-only "remote" role. Note it orders results NON-chronologically, so read the date on each row rather than trusting position.

Do NOT waste calls on: weworkremotely, welcometothejungle, landing.jobs, jobicy, linkedin.com/jobs, nofluffjobs, EURES/europa.eu, jobs.eu, workatastartup, remotive, workingnomads, freelancermap. All dead, blocked or render nothing.
remoterocketship.com is SIGNAL ONLY — its pages expose no direct-apply URL, so you cannot source a row from it. If you use it, take company + title from it and then find the original ATS posting with a WebSearch before returning the row.

VERIFICATION — every row you return must come from a posting page you actually fetched and confirmed live. Board listings alone are NOT enough: follow through to the real posting (usually an ATS URL) and read the eligibility sentence from that page.
- Greenhouse: a single-posting fetch that returns MANY different jobs means the posting is CLOSED — drop it.
- Personio closed postings hard-404. Append ?language=en.
- An Ashby JS shell ("You need to enable JavaScript") means the FETCH failed, not that the role closed.
- Read the ELIGIBILITY SENTENCE, not the word "Remote" in the title.

DROP: language requirements beyond English; ML research/PhD/foundation-model training/CUDA/heavy data engineering; staffing agencies, body shops and aggregators with no named end client (Jobgether especially); unpaid, equity-only or talent-pool listings; Staff/Principal/Head of/Director titles or 7+ years; anything you cannot confirm is live.

RETURN: a JSON array ONLY, no prose. Each object:
{"company":"", "role":"", "url":"direct apply URL, not the board listing", "location_wording":"exact eligibility sentence", "comp":"as stated or empty", "posted":"as stated or empty", "basis":"employment|contract", "stack":"named tools", "seniority":"years or level asked", "why_fit":"one honest sentence", "watchouts":"honest risks"}

Aim for 10-16 verified roles. If fewer than 7, go back and work more of the euremotejobs region paths.
